title: Grateful Dead Live at Civic Arena on 1989-04-02
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi Dragon > Tascam CDR > EAC > WavMerge > Soundforge > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC. Taped and transferred thru CDR by Jon Pasternak, EAC thru FLAC by Andrew F. January 2008. - pitch correction and patches by Kevin Tobin
source: (original shnid = 89780) AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP4's > Marantz PMD-420, front row of OTS.

ai_review.summary: Upfront audience tape with crisp, slightly tinny sound captures a well‑played, rehearsal‑tight show.
ai_review.review: The performance is described as very tight and almost rehearsed, earning the reviewer a solid 4‑star rating. The audience recording is praised for its upfront presence, clarity and FM‑broadcast‑like quality, though it suffers from a slight tinny character and occasional compression artifacts. Overall the show shines despite modest recording imperfections.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed review rates the show 4/5, highlighting strong musical execution and generally good but imperfect audio quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crispy, upfront sound with no hiss; slightly tinny and a bit compressed like a low‑quality MP3, reminiscent of an FM broadcast. Good enough to blend with a soundboard feed.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewer emphasizes overall tightness and rehearsal‑like precision.
